ReturnsRefundsPage.title: Simple Returns, Clear Refunds
ReturnsRefundsPage.description: Review our return and refund policy, understand the process, and find answers to common questions.

policy.title: Return and Refund Conditions
policy.description: Please review these conditions before submitting a return request.

returnWindow.title: Return Window
returnWindow.description: Eligible products may be returned within 14 days of delivery.

productCondition.title: Product Condition
productCondition.description: Products must be unused, undamaged, and returned in their original packaging.

proofOfPurchase.title: Proof of Purchase
proofOfPurchase.description: A valid receipt, order confirmation, or order number is required.

refundMethod.title: Refund Method
refundMethod.description: Approved refunds are returned through the original payment method.

steps.title: Return Process
steps.description: Follow these steps to request a return and receive your refund.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: Contact our support team and provide your order details and reason for return.

review.title: Request Review
review.description: Our team will review your request and confirm whether the product is eligible.

return.title: Return the Product
return.description: After approval, follow the provided instructions to return the product.

refund.title: Receive Your Refund
refund.description: Once the returned product is inspected, the approved refund will be processed.

note.title: Important Information
note.description: Do not return a product before receiving approval and return instructions from our support team.

accepted.title: Returns We Accept
accepted.unused: Unused products returned in their original condition.
accepted.packaging: Products returned with their original packaging, labels, and accessories.
accepted.receipt: Returns supported by a valid receipt or order confirmation.
accepted.damaged: Products received damaged, defective, or different from the item ordered.

excluded.title: Returns We Cannot Accept
excluded.used: Products that have been used, damaged, altered, or improperly handled after delivery.
excluded.personalCare: Personal-care, hygiene, or other sealed products that have been opened.
excluded.clearance: Clearance or final-sale products unless they arrived damaged or defective.
excluded.missingParts: Products returned without their original parts, accessories, labels, or packaging.

faq.title: Returns and Refunds FAQ
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about returns, refunds, exchanges, and delivery issues.

time.question: How long do I have to return a product?
time.answer: Eligible products may be returned within 14 days of delivery. The product must meet all return conditions.

delivery.question: What should I do if my order arrives damaged?
delivery.answer: Contact our support team as soon as possible and provide your order number, a description of the issue, and clear photos of the damaged product and packaging.

exchange.question: Can I exchange a product instead of requesting a refund?
exchange.answer: Exchanges may be available depending on product availability. Contact our support team so we can review your request.

damaged.question: What happens after my returned product is received?
damaged.answer: The product will be inspected. Once the return is approved, your refund or eligible exchange will be processed.

shipping.question: Who pays the return delivery cost?
shipping.answer: Return delivery costs depend on the reason for the return. If the product is damaged, defective, or incorrect, we will review the delivery cost with your request.

cta.title: Need Help With a Return?
cta.description: Contact our support team for assistance or track your existing order.
